C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 7041
Date
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 1st 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir, General Yang visited Zung Tsung Hyan 岑春煊
ex Commandant of the Republican troops
of Canton and Kwangsi at his residence No.306
Avenue Joffre on 30th instant. The local
officials and notables have decided to entertain
Zung on 2nd instant.

Fifty rebels met in Zee Oen 全安 teashop
in Rue Wagner at 2 p.m. yesterday and decided
to form a begging party in order to raise funds
to take them to their homes.
Zung Vung Hyui 陳文樞 and Kwoh Tsa 郭超
were appointed leaders of the Party. The manner
in which they will ask for charity will be
decided later.

It is reported that the National Herald
has been sold to a representative of Premier
Tuan Chi Jui for $60,000.00.

Your Obedient Servant,
M B Newton
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记册
编号 7041
日期
上海工部局。
1916年12月1日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

先生，杨将军于本月30日前往霞飞路306号寓所拜访了前广东及广西共和军司令岑春煊。本地官员及名流已决定于本月2日宴请岑氏。

昨日下午2时，五十名叛乱分子在瓦格纳路的全安茶馆集会，决定组成一个乞讨团，以筹集资金供他们返乡。陈文樞和郭超被推举为该团首领。至于他们将采取何种方式行乞，待日后决定。

据报，《国民公报》已以60,000.00美元的价格出售给段祺瑞总理的一位代表。

您顺从的仆人，
M B Newton
侦探副督察。

警察总监上尉。
